import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "src"))
from do_again.browser import cdp
from do_again.browser.runtime import browser_status, browser_self_test, project_record, _find_chatgpt_target, _page_contains
from do_again.service.runtime import runtime_layout

result = browser_self_test()
raw = result.get("response", "").strip()
label = "ChatGPT said:"
body = raw[len(label):].strip() if raw.startswith(label) else raw
report = {"authenticated_round_trip": {"passed": body == "DO_AGAIN_BROWSER_OK", "raw_response": raw, "message_body": body, "chat_url": result.get("chat_url")}}

layout = runtime_layout(repo)
receipt_id = "live-e2e-20261007T191505-b6c9"
outbox = layout.state_dir / "browser_outbox" / (receipt_id + ".json")
deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
delivery = {}
while True:
    status = browser_status()
    record = project_record(repo)
    target = _find_chatgpt_target(int(status["port"]), record.get("chat_url")) if status.get("running") else None
    posted = bool(target and _page_contains(target, "DO_AGAIN_RECEIPT_READY request_id=" + receipt_id + " state="))
    pending = outbox.exists()
    delivery = {"marker_posted": posted, "receipt_still_queued": pending, "chat_url": record.get("chat_url"), "browser_mode": status.get("mode")}
    if posted and not pending:
        break
    if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(2)
delivery["passed"] = delivery["marker_posted"] and not delivery["receipt_still_queued"]
state_path = layout.state_dir / "browser_status.json"
delivery["delivery_state"] = json.loads(state_path.read_text()) if state_path.exists() else None
report["automatic_receipt_delivery"] = delivery
report["passed"] = report["authenticated_round_trip"]["passed"] and delivery["passed"]
print("DO_AGAIN_LIVE_CONFIRMATION=" + json.dumps(report), flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if report["passed"] else 1)
